first_impression.reaction: I typed 'greece wedding cost' and the first thing I get is 'it depends'. Okay, at least it says so straight away and doesn't make me scroll through a story about sunsets first. I'll check the Key takeaways to see if there's a number hiding in there. There isn't. I skim one section and the FAQ, then I'm probably off to another tab to find an actual ballpark.

journey.quote: A single figure blends all of those together and says very little about your own wedding.
journey.reaction: Fair point, and honest. But it reads a bit like the page is talking me out of the question I came here to ask. Just tell me how much it costs, even roughly.

journey.quote: Below is what shapes the total, what a package bundles, how paying in euro from Australia works and what to ask before you request a number.
journey.reaction: Good, it tells me what's on the page so I can decide fast. It also tells me there's no number here. 'From Australia' makes me think this isn't really for me.

journey.quote: The total for a wedding in Greece is set by island, venue type, season, guest numbers and how much guest travel you cover, so ask every venue to quote against the same written brief.
journey.reaction: Clear, scannable, early on the page. Useful tip about the same brief for every venue. Still not an answer to 'how much'.

journey.section: Season and day of the week
journey.quote: As at November 2026, Smartraveller says heatwaves are frequent in Greece over the summer months, and wildfires occur in the extended summer period from June to September.
journey.reaction: Dated and sourced. That answers my 'is this still true in 2026?' worry. I trust this section more than a random blog.

journey.quote: Taxes and service charges, and whether they sit inside the quoted price.
journey.reaction: This list is actually handy. I'd screenshot this one for when I get quotes.

journey.quote: It depends on the wedding you plan. Island, venue, season, guest numbers and guest travel all move the total.
journey.reaction: I jumped to the FAQ hoping for a short answer and got the same 'it depends' again. Two FAQs in a row saying the same thing feels like padding.

journey.quote: The total depends on the drivers above: island and venue, date, guest list, legal route, the events across the weekend and what you cover for guests.
journey.reaction: This is the exact question I searched and it's the third time I've read 'depends'. If you won't give a figure, at least say plainly that you're not giving one and why, then point me to something that does.

journey.quote: This is general information about Australian law as at November 2026, not legal advice.
journey.reaction: Not relevant to me, I'd skip this. Fine for Australians I guess.

unanswered_questions: Even a rough range: what does a small wedding in Greece cost versus a big one?
Is Santorini or Mykonos noticeably pricier than Crete, or is that a myth?
Is this guide useful if I'm not Australian, and does Wedded Wonderland work with couples outside Australia?
Which of the linked guides, if any, actually has a price or range in it?

turn_offs_found.quote: The total depends on the drivers above: island and venue, date, guest list, legal route, the events across the weekend and what you cover for guests.
turn_offs_found.why: The heading matches my query word for word but the answer doesn't answer it. That's the 'heading doesn't match the question' feeling, just in reverse.

turn_offs_found.quote: Ask whether the quote, deposit and balance are invoiced in euro or AUD.
turn_offs_found.why: Lots of the page assumes I'm paying in AUD from Australia. Not a dealbreaker but it tells me I'm not the audience.

would_share_with: My fiance, but only the 'Items quoted separately' list, as a checklist

cta_reaction.quote: Your Wedded Advisor quotes in AUD for Australian couples and has inclusions confirmed in writing before you commit.
cta_reaction.why: I don't know this brand, I'm on my phone on the train, and I came for a quick answer, not a conversation. 'For Australian couples' also makes me unsure they'd even help me. Maybe I'd bookmark the page, not enquire.

top_3_changes: Intro: old "A single figure blends all of those together and says very little about your own wedding." new "A single figure blends all of those together and says very little about your own wedding, so this guide does not give one. It gives you what to get quoted, in writing, so your own number is real."

FAQ: old "The total depends on the drivers above: island and venue, date, guest list, legal route, the events across the weekend and what you cover for guests. Ask each venue to quote against the same written brief, then compare line by line." new "There is no honest single answer, because the total depends on island and venue, date, guest list, legal route, the events across the weekend and what you cover for guests. The fastest way to a real number is to send each venue the same written brief, then compare the quotes line by line."

FAQ: old "It depends on the wedding you plan. Island, venue, season, guest numbers and guest travel all move the total." new "It can be, or it can be modest. A town hall ceremony with lunch for close family and a weekend at a clifftop venue sit at very different ends, and island, season and guest travel move the total most."
